Microsoft reported another solid result for F2Q, but it ultimately fell short of more 
lofty market expectations, in particular for Azure growth. While most investors 
continue to hone in on this as the most important KPI, mgmt. again made it clear 
Azure is bearing the brunt of current supply constraints as they prioritize GPU 
allocation in support of AI usage in first-party apps and R&D to accelerate product 
innovation in pursuit of higher margin, recurring software opportunities up the 
stack. So while Azure growth still came in 1pt above guidance at +38% y/y @CC, 
this was shy of what we believe was a buyside bogey of >39%+ and what mgmt. 
indicated would have been >40% had they allocated all incremental GPU capacity 
in F1H26 to Azure. Importantly, we'd highlight Azure is still growing well above the 
market, guided to sustain 37-38% growth in F3Q and we believe can likely persist 
near here for several more quarters off a higher base.
From a margin and LTV perspective we believe the application layer has and is still 
generally perceived as highly strategic ground on which Microsoft has incumbent 
advantages. But we'd argue it is also the last area to see tangible benefits as AI 
monetization works its way up the stack, and is more than ever viewed as at risk of 
disruption and/or devaluation, which is weighing on sentiment. That story has yet 
to play out in our view, so while foregoing Azure revenue now for high-margin 
application and consumer SW opportunity ahead seems a sensible long-term 
strategy, it puts the onus on Microsoft to deliver before it will get credit. We continue 
to see more evidence of steadily growing traction, including new disclosure this 
quarter of 15m paid M365 Copilot seats (accelerating q/q and +160% y/y), paid

Azure 供應受限時，Microsoft 點解仲有力推 E7 加價式 upsell？

text:
### 原因分析
1. **優先 allocGPU支持AI應用**：當Azure供應受限時，Microsoft優先將GPU分配給第一方應用程序的AI使用和R&D，以加速產品創新，追求更高利潤的重複軟件機會。這意味著Azure的部分增長可能受到影響，但公司更關注上層應用程序（如M365 Copilot、Agent 365等）的AI貨幣化，E7 SKU的推出正是為了推動這些上層應用的 adoption。【KB:20260205_Deutsche_Bank_MSFT_Microsoft-_F2Q_L】
2. **E7 SKU整合多項關鍵功能**：E7 SKU包含M365 E5、Entra Suite、Agent 365和M365 Copilot，這些功能是AI時代企業數字轉型的核心需求。通過整合銷售，公司可以更有效地推廣高價值產品，利用現有E3/E5用戶基礎進行升級銷售，創造額外收入。【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adop】
3. **應對邊際壓力並維持增長**：Azure供應受限導致邊際下降，但E7 SKU等高毛利產品可以彌補部分損失。此外，M365 Copilot和Agent 365的 adoption 可以帶來穩定的ARPU增長，支撐公司的整體收入和利潤。【KB:20260205_Mizuho_Securities_MSFT_MSFT-_Good_O, KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adop】
